abstract: Improving access to formal finance is crucial for the growth of women-owned enterprises in emerging economies. This paper investigates whether the use of technology enhances access to formal credit for women entrepreneurs in India’s unorganized sector. Based on enterprise-level data from the Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (ASUSE) 2022–2023 round, we present the following key findings: (1) Women-owned enterprises are significantly less likely to obtain formal credit and, when they obtain loans, they secure smaller loan amounts, confirming a gender gap in accessing formal credit. (2) Technology usage, captured by computer and internet usage, improves both the likelihood of receiving formal loans and the size of loans for women-owned firms, reflecting the positive effect of technology adoption in bridging the gender gap. (3) Women-owned enterprises adopting technology witness improved access to formal credit through the use of the internet for banking and accessing other financial services. (4) The positive formal credit access-enhancing effect of technology usage is driven by rural firms in terms of loan access and by both rural and urban firms in terms of loan amounts. These results have significant implications for promoting gender equity in accessing formal finance through targeted digital interventions for women entrepreneurs. KEYWORDS: financial inclusion gender gap technology adoption women entrepreneurs JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 J16 L26 O33
abstract_zh: 改善正规融资渠道对于新兴经济体中女性创办企业的成长至关重要。本文探究了技术应用是否有助于印度非正规部门女性创业者获得正规信贷。基于2022-2023年度《非正规部门企业年度调查》（ASUSE）的企业层面数据，我们得出以下主要发现：（1）女性创办企业获得正规信贷的可能性显著更低，且即使获得贷款，其贷款金额也较小，这证实了正规信贷获取中存在性别差距。（2）以计算机和互联网使用衡量的技术应用，既提高了女性创办企业获得正规贷款的可能性，也增加了贷款规模，反映出技术采纳在弥合性别差距方面的积极作用。（3）采用技术的女性创办企业通过使用互联网进行银行业务及获取其他金融服务，改善了正规信贷的可及性。（4）技术应用对正规信贷获取的积极促进作用，在贷款可得性方面由农村企业驱动，而在贷款金额方面则由城乡企业共同驱动。这些结论对于通过针对女性创业者的定向数字干预措施促进正规融资领域的性别平等具有重要政策启示。关键词：金融包容性 性别差距 技术采纳 女性创业者 JEL分类号：G21 J16 L26 O33

abstract: This note discusses the empirical findings of Bahmani-Oskooee and Wang (2008), thereafter BOW. In their analysis, BOW suggest that the J-curve phenomenon holds in 22 US industries with China as a trading partner. However, it turns out that there is a misinterpretation of their findings. We show that the J-curve hypothesis is extremely questionable in at least 10 cases out of those 22 industries, claimed by BOW that the J-curve holds.
abstract_zh: 本注释讨论了Bahmani-Oskooee和Wang（2008）的实证发现，以下简称BOW。在他们的分析中，BOW提出，在22个美国行业中，以中国为贸易伙伴时，J曲线现象成立。然而，事实证明，他们的发现存在误解。我们表明，在BOW声称J曲线成立的这22个行业中，至少有10个案例中，J曲线假说极为可疑。
